_: Counter attendants (workstream Q, design/godot-dialogue.md 'Attendants'). One unique person behind each counter. wing/years: where they exist (a store closed that year has none). skin: an npc/skins.json id the wing's pack ships (Ch*/Remy); Steven may swap. area: [x0, z0, x1, z1] world metres behind the counter they wander in; face: the direction they stand facing (toward the shop floor); talk_at: where the interactable stands (the shop side of the counter, so the 1.6 m reach works across it). name and dialogue are PLACEHOLDERs until Steven writes them. redemption: true = the redemption screen (session R) opens first when it exists. INT (Demo 49): "spots" (workstream GI) are places only; story.gd reads "attendants" and ignores "spots". look (B2, design/godot-character-editor.md): "preset" = a B1 body dressed from data/characters/<preset>.json; "legacy" = the Mixamo skin above (the fallback when the preset is missing). shop (SHOPS, design/godot-shops.md): a shop id in data/story/shops.json; talking opens its list (scripts/shop.gd) instead of a dialogue.
